g.text: Mirroring follows the selected output; an own feed is independent.
16 record channels are available; additional DAW and optical routes continue below.
Each input strip: source, pan, level meter, fader, solo and mute. Scroll horizontally for all 16 inputs.
Set through macOS, so this matches Audio MIDI Setup.
Choose the clock source on the Symphony itself.
Hold one of the rotary encoders to select internal, word clock or digital input.
Rate changes are managed by macOS Audio MIDI Setup.
A profile stores monitoring, headphone feeds, I/O levels, routing and both mixers.
The last recalled profile is marked with a check.
